# Test m3: data-toc-label with attr_list
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-c', r'''
import markdown

md_text = """[TOC]

# Foo & Bar { data-toc-label="Custom & Label" }
"""
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=["toc", "attr_list"])
html = md.convert(md_text)
print("HTML:", html)
print("TOC tokens:", md.toc_tokens)
print()
tok = md.toc_tokens[0]
print(f"name: {repr(tok['name'])}")
print(f"html: {repr(tok['html'])}")
print(f"data-toc-label: {repr(tok['data-toc-label'])}")
print(f"id: {tok['id']}")
'''],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd='.'
)
print("STDOUT:", result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-500:])
